geometry_edits.rationale: Wrap the current dominant mass in a courtyard operator to introduce a usable public void without losing the existing stepped character.
Increase the carved margin enough to be legible in plan and section.
Align the opening to the verified access side to recover the public threshold relation.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the stepped-only dominant mass with a courtyard-forming operation to create a legible public void tied to the ground plane while preserving the overall compact stepped gesture.
Set a substantial margin so the void reads as public space rather than a shallow chip.
Open the court to the program access side so the frontage becomes an active threshold rather than a sealed edge.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent stepped mass across all four views, so it succeeds as a single massing idea and does not visibly collide across views. However, for neighborhood living it fails the semantic core because the ground plane is sealed: the verified access edge is not met with a court, notch, undercut, or other public threshold. The form reads more like a compact stepped object or generic terraced block than a street-building with active frontage and one clear public void. The parcel containment appears respected, and the silhouette is legible, but the public-space requirement is not met, so program_fit_hard_pass must fail.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Candidate is much more compact and low; no tower or strong vertical civic marker, so only the stepped section principle transfers.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped/tapered upper mass can read as a coherent civic-commercial figure when the base remains grounded and the profile is continuous.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference relies on a pronounced internal eye; candidate currently lacks any comparable carved void.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Central void or atrium can organize a rectilinear mass and create a legible public/interior threshold.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is mostly single-story and relies on canopy/frontage rather than stacked massing; candidate’s stepped stack is a different typology.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A simple grounded base with a clear public edge can support neighborhood-serving program when the threshold is active.

warnings: Strong stepped hierarchy but no legible public void or entry seam at the verified access edge.
The mass reads as a self-contained object rather than an active neighborhood ground condition.
Program demands an active ground threshold; current form is semantically opposite by remaining mostly sealed at grade.
